critique: The note proves a sharp globally honest expected-diameter frontier for all nonempty margin strata, plus a matching oracle frontier only for gamma at most kappa_star/2 and for one thresholded N=3, r=s=1 endpoint experiment. It does not characterize R_or or the adaptation ratio on intermediate margins, because oeq:all-margin-oracle leaves disconnected loading components and finite classification transitions unresolved. The four-line endpoint cannot substitute for that missing general result, and the N=8 computation supplies neither a maximal-margin certificate nor an oracle transition theorem. The restrictive fixed-dimensional Gaussian and exactly normalized deterministic-factor class, the incomplete oracle kernel, and the absence of substantive finite-sample or application evidence limit the projected leading-journal score despite the delivered global frontier being a genuine field-level contribution.
